{
  "summary": "The function processes an input buffer and computes a 64-bit value based on a custom algorithm involving two 32-bit variables, a and b, which are updated in a loop over the input bytes. The result is a combination of a and b, with b shifted left by 16 bits.",
  "proposed_name": "fn_10",
  "algorithm": "unknown",
  "self_confidence": 1.0,
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "user_1",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "Iterates over the input buffer using a for loop.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "user_2",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "Updates the variable a using the formula a = (in[i] + a) % 0xffef.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "user_3",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "Updates the variable b using the formula b = (b + a) % 0xffef.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "user_4",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "Returns the result of combining a and b, with b shifted left by 16 bits.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "user_5",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns a 64-bit value when the input length is greater than zero.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "user_6",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "Does not write to out.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "user_7",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "Uses the constant 0xffef.",
      "asserted_values": ["0xffef"],
      "confidence": 1.0
    }
  ],
  "recovered_c": "uint64_t fn_10(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  uint32_t a = 1;\n  uint32_t b = 0;\n  size_t i;\n\n  for (i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n    a = (in[i] + a) % 0xffef;\n    b = (b + a) % 0xffef;\n  }\n\n  return (uint64_t)a | (uint64_t)b << 16;\n}"
}
